release_notes.text: Bounded Strategy Lab OpenD sampling after the first confirmed provider rate limit, deferring the remaining collection work instead of exhausting the service runtime budget while preserving fail-closed handling for other collection errors.

Made IQ stock-refresh evidence trust explicit no-trigger, option-only, dry-run, and already-synchronized outcomes while keeping observed activity without an intent unavailable and rejected or failed refreshes partial.
